title: Webtoon 'Overgeared' Gets TV Anime in Fall 2026
content: Production company Pony Canyon opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Saenal Park and Team Argo 's Overgeared webtoon on Wednesday. The website also revealed the main cast, staff, teaser visual (pictured), and a teaser promotional video.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'Fired? But I Maintain All the Software!' Light Novels Get TV Anime
content: Publisher Shufu to Seikatsu Sha announced on Wednesday that Yuki Kashirome 's Fired? But I Maintain All the Software! ( E, Shanai System Subete Wanope Shiteiru Watashi wo Kaiko desu ka? ) light novel series is inspiring a television anime adaptation . The announcement did not reveal any further details on the anime.
author: ANN

title: Overgeared Anime Announced, Reveals First Trailer, Visual, Staff, October 2026 Premiere
content: Overgeared anime adaptation was officially announced today, revealing the first teaser visual and trailer ahead of its October 2026 debut. The studio, main staff and cast were also revealed..
author: Anime Corner

title: 'E, Shanai System Subete Wanope Shiteiru Watashi wo Kaiko desu ka?' TV Anime Adaptation Announced
content: Publishing company Shufu to Seikatsusha announced a television anime adaptation of Meyuki Kashiro 's E, Shanai System Subete Wanope Shiteiru Watashi wo Kaiko desu ka? ( Fired? But I Maintain All the Software! ) manga on Wednesday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 13 Year Ago, Your Name Director’s Most Underrated Anime Premiered
content: Makoto Shinkai is one of the most renowned names in the anime industry known for directing several acclaimed films such as Your Name, Voices of a Distant Star , and more. He is also the founder CoMix Wave Films, a studio dedicated for visually-appealing animation and focusing mostly on romantic stories.
author: ComicBook

title: 10 Years Later, Forgotten Historical Fantasy Confirms 2026 Premiere For Anime Revival
content: The anime and manga industry is heavily dominated by the Shonen demographic, and most of the mainstream series are purely battle action. Most of the best-selling manga of all time are also Shonen series, including One Piece, Naruto, Dragon Ball, Demon Slayer, and more.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll’s Biggest Fantasy Sequel of Summer 2026 Confirms Early Release
content: The Spring 2026 anime season is finally here, and the lineup looks as exciting as ever. 2026 kicked off with some of the biggest anime in recent years, including Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Season 2, Jujutsu Kaisen Season 3, and many more.
author: ComicBook

title: Dynasty Warriors 3 Remastered Game's Trailer Confirms Ziluan, October 1 Launch
content: Koei Tecmo confirmed the addition of Dynasty Warriors: Origins protagonist Ziluan and the October 1 launch for Dynasty Warriors 3: Complete Edition Remastered , a remastered version of its original 2001 game, in a new trailer during Sony 's "State of Play" livestream on Tuesday.
author: ANN

title: Silent Hill: Townfall Game Launches on September 24

title: Despite a Long Hiatus, Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Tops The Sales Ranking
content: Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Season 2 is one of the most anticipated anime series of 2026, as the story will continue the journey towards Aureole. After Fern officially becomes a First Class Mage, Frieren’s party has the permit to continue their travel to the northernmost part of the continent.
